def use(world: World, actor: Actor, bag: Bag, item_id: str) -> int:

    if item.kind == "shield_tonic":
        # Shield tonic increases shield by its power, consumed on use, does not heal HP
        # Designer decision R3.2: shield cap is 5
        shield_increase = item.power
        if actor.shield + shield_increase > 5:
            bag.add(item)
            raise ValueError("shield at maximum (5), cannot use tonic")
        actor.shield += shield_increase
        world.emit(Event("shield_tonic", actor.actor_id, amount=shield_increase))
        return shield_increase
    elif item.kind == "antidote":
        # Antidote removes poison status, consumed on use
        if "poison" in actor.statuses:
            del actor.statuses["poison"]
            world.emit(Event("antidote", actor.actor_id))
            return item.power
        bag.add(item)
        raise ValueError("no poison status to remove")
    elif item.kind != "potion":
        bag.add(item)
        raise ValueError("item is not usable")
    healed = actor.heal(item.power)
    world.emit(Event("heal", actor.actor_id, amount=healed))
    return healed

def use(world: World, actor: Actor, bag: Bag, item_id: str) -> int:
    item = bag.remove(item_id)
    if item.kind == "shield_tonic":
        # Shield tonic increases shield by its power, consumed on use, does not heal HP
        # Designer decision R3.2: shield cap is 5
        shield_increase = item.power
        if actor.shield + shield_increase > 5:
            bag.add(item)
            raise ValueError("shield at maximum (5), cannot use tonic")
        actor.shield += shield_increase
        world.emit(Event("shield_tonic", actor.actor_id, amount=shield_increase))
        return shield_increase
    elif item.kind != "potion":
        bag.add(item)
        raise ValueError("item is not usable")
    healed = actor.heal(item.power)
    world.emit(Event("heal", actor.actor_id, amount=healed))
    return healed
